_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored and will never be committed.

opportunities.label: Important Email
opportunities.description: Actual people, customers, friends, partners, prospects, school/family logistics, paid work, and direct asks you cannot afford to miss.

money_admin.label: Money/Admin
money_admin.description: Bills, receipts, refunds, affiliate payouts, bank notices, and account admin. Usually not immediate.

learning_events.label: Learning/Events
learning_events.description: Newsletters, webinars, launches, and event blasts. Useful later, not urgent.

sales_pitches.label: Sales Pitches
sales_pitches.description: Cold outreach and people selling you something.

lm_studio._model_note: Check LM Studio > Local Server tab for the exact model name string. Recommended: qwen2.5-3b-instruct (best for classification, ~2GB RAM). Alternatives: qwen3-4b-instruct, phi-3.5-mini, llama-3.2-3b-instruct, smollm3-3b

telegram._help: Bot token from @BotFather. Chat ID from @userinfobot.
